lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Monday. 9 AM. Everyone in town is looking for a house... and my phone is dead silent.

lines.speaker: lena
lines.text: Marcus, they're all asking ChatGPT. And it keeps saying Prime Nest.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Prime Nest? They spelled kitchen wrong on their last listing!

lines.speaker: lena
lines.text: They claimed their business on ChatGPT. We didn't. Watch.

lines.speaker: lena
lines.text: Business Hub. Search Keystone Realty. Get Started. Verify with our office phone. Quick ID check...

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Wait. Is that a blue check? On our sign?

lines.speaker: lena
lines.text: It launched November tenth, and it's free. Most agencies still haven't done it.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Okay... who's buying a house today?

lines.speaker: lena
lines.text: Want the checklist? Follow @nxtlvlsocial.ai and comment CHATGPT.
